load_error.title: Artifact load failed: %s
load_error.sugg: File may be corrupted or permission denied; diagnostic results may be incomplete.

invalid_pending_rewrites.title: Rework queue contains unfinished chapters: [%s]
invalid_pending_rewrites.sugg: State invariant corrupted. Stop execution and edit meta/progress.json to remove unfinished chapters from pending_rewrites; if queue is empty, set flow to writing and clear rewrite_reason.

rewrite_pending_pressure.title: Pending rewrite chapters: [%s]
rewrite_pending_pressure.sugg: Check if Editor review criteria are too strict or Writer rewrite prompt is effective. Engine will automatically remove repeatedly failing chapters.

orphaned_steer.title: Unconsumed steering instruction exists
orphaned_steer.sugg: Steer instruction was persisted but not consumed by intervention arbiter. Check recovery logic or overwrite by re-submitting.

phase_flow_mismatch.title: Phase/flow state mismatch: phase=%s, flow=%s
phase_flow_mismatch.evidence: phase=%s should not have non-initial flow=%s
phase_flow_mismatch.sugg: State machine may be corrupted. Inspect meta/progress.json phase and flow fields.

chapter_gaps.title: Chapter numbering gap: missing [%s]
chapter_gaps.sugg: commit_chapter may have been interrupted. Check meta/pending_commit.json.

chronic_low_dimension.title: Dimension [%s] chronically low (avg %.0f)
chronic_low_dimension.sugg: Check Writer prompt guidance for %s or Editor scoring criteria.

contract_miss_pattern.title: Low contract fulfillment rate (%.0f%% missed)
contract_miss_pattern.sugg: Writer may not have read contract or required_beats too aggressive. Check plan_chapter and writer.md.

hook_weak_chain.title: Chapter end hook consecutively weak (%d chapters in a row)
hook_weak_chain.sugg: Check writer.md hook_goal execution, clarify reader hook in plan_chapter, calibrate Editor hook criteria.

payoff_miss_pattern.title: Payoff delivery rate low (%.0f%% missed)
payoff_miss_pattern.sugg: Check if plan_chapter payoff_points are overloaded or vague; ensure Writer delivers payoffs in chapter body.

excessive_rewrites.title: Excessive rewrite rate (%d/%d = %.0f%%)
excessive_rewrites.sugg: Writer continuously outputs below Editor threshold. Align Writer prompt with Editor criteria.

word_count_anomaly.title: Chapter word count anomaly (avg %d words)
word_count_anomaly.sugg: Extremely short chapters may indicate token truncation; long chapters consume extra context. Check model max_tokens.

stale_foreshadow.title: Stagnant foreshadowing: %d items unprogressed for >%d chapters
stale_foreshadow.sugg: novel_context foreshadow reminder may not be effective or Writer prompt lacks guidance. Check foreshadow_ledger and context injection.

compass_drift.missing_sugg: Architect should create compass during initial planning. Check architect-long.md.
compass_drift.stale_sugg: Architect should update compass at arc/volume boundaries. Check architect-long.md.

outline_exhausted.title: Outline exhausted: completed %d chapters >= planned %d chapters
outline_exhausted.sugg: Arc expansion or new volume signal was not triggered. Check host commit strategy and recovery logic.

missing_summaries.title: Missing summaries: %d chapters without summary
missing_summaries.sugg: Summaries are essential for context continuity. Check commit_chapter summary persistence.

ghost_character.title: Missing character: %d core characters absent for long period
ghost_character.sugg: Writer may have lost character tracking. Steer in input box to re-introduce character or downgrade tier in characters.json.

timeline_gaps.empty_sugg: commit_chapter timeline extraction may not have taken effect. Check Writer timeline output.
timeline_gaps.gap_sugg: commit_chapter timeline extraction may be partially failing. Check Writer timeline output format.

relationship_stagnation.title: Relationship data stagnant: latest update at chapter %d
relationship_stagnation.sugg: commit_chapter relationship updates may have stopped or story relationships have not changed.

repeated_tool_error.title: Tool repeatedly returns same error
repeated_tool_error.sugg: Same tool repeatedly returns same error near tail; check agentcore tool validation / prompt parameter contract (#34).

args_invalid_loop.title: Parameters repeatedly failed to parse
args_invalid_loop.sugg: Model sent parameters that fail parsing yet continuously retries; check agentcore coercion (#34).

stuck_step.title: Checkpoint stuck on same step
stuck_step.sugg: Same step repeatedly written without advancing; locate stuck subagent from repeat signatures.

stream_idle_storm.title: Frequent stream interruptions (stream_idle)
stream_idle_storm.sugg: Upstream delayed token generation killed by watchdog; increase streamIdleTimeout for reasoning models or check provider connection stability (#32).

state_machine_fix.msg: State machine anomaly: %s. Inspect and fix progress phase/flow before continuing.

outline_exhausted.msg: Completed chapters reached planned limit. Invoke Architect to expand next arc or append volume before writing.

orphaned_steer.msg: Unconsumed user steering instruction exists. Process pending steer before resuming current task.
